description:
What this workspace has already researched, by kind, with the date each piece was written and how old it is. A held answer is immediate; researching the same subject again spends Research Tokens to learn nothing new.

Asked as: what do we already have on them · have we looked at this person before · what changed since we last looked · what have we run on this company.

Free.

about.description: Limit to one kind of research. `person` is one circle, `people` a goal read across one or more people’s circles, `chain` a route to somebody out of reach, `company` a roster and `company-intent` one read for a goal. Out means everything held.

ask.description: What this is for, in your user's own words. It does not filter what comes back — `about` does that. It is recorded in this session, and later calls weigh their answers against it.

name: orbbai_held
title: Research We Already Hold
